subject: Deployment readiness and benchmarking run: plan + acceptance criteria
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@nimbuscloud.com>, eng@nimbuscloud.com
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Deployment readiness and benchmarking run: plan + acceptance criteria

Hi Elena / Nimbus team —

Thanks again for the sync today. Per our SOW kickoff, attached is the proposed benchmarking runbook we intend to execute during the onboarding window (attached: redwood-benchmark-template.xlsx and nimbus-load-plan.csv). High level plan:

- Wednesday 2026-10-21: Controlled throughput ramp (staged clients simulating 50, 200, 500 concurrent sessions).
- Thursday 2026-10-22: Sustained soak for 2 hours at agreed production concurrency for peak region (US-West).
- Friday 2026-10-23: Acceptance verification run + regression checks, final report.

Acceptance criteria (we want these agreed before runs):
1) 95th percentile generation latency <= 300ms for short prompts (<=128 tokens).
2) Median throughput >= 1200 tokens/sec across the GPU pool for mixed requests.
3) No more than 0.5% error rate (5xx or model timeouts) during soak.
4) Successful KV cache hit behavior: prefix caching reduces upstream compute by >= 18% (as measured in reported metrics).

Please confirm the concurrency targets and whether your infra can route test traffic from your staging VPC (preferred) or if we should run from our Dedicated test pool and record network delta.

Action items I propose:
- Nimbus: confirm staging IPs and point of ingress by EOD tomorrow.
- Redwood: we'll prepare load harness and a shared Grafana dashboard; Dev will coordinate test execution.
- Rishi / Monica: I'll loop you in for billing/credits and SLA uplift conversation after acceptance.

Attachments: redwood-benchmark-template.xlsx, nimbus-load-plan.csv

Thanks — looking forward to the runs.

—
Grace O'Connor
Customer Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0189

From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@nimbuscloud.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: eng@nimbuscloud.com
Date: 2026-10-20T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Deployment readiness and benchmarking run: plan + acceptance criteria

Thanks Grace — this looks great and aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side: 

- We can provide staging IPs from our US-West staging VPC. I'll share a CIDR block and an SSH jump host today.
- For concurrency targets: our production expected steady concurrency is ~350 sessions, with peak bursts to ~650 for short windows. Can we add an explicit test step at 650 concurrency (10 minute burst) to validate graceful degradation/fallback?
- Latency SLA: 300ms (P95) is aggressive but acceptable for short prompts if the model variant is the optimized q8_onnx build. We'll need confirmation of the model variant you'll run in the Dedicated pool.

One more ask: can Redwood provide a sample of the dashboard metrics we'll get during the run? Our ops team wants to verify that per-route token breakdowns and KV cache hit rate are visible.

I'll attach the staging IPs in a follow-up.

Elena Morales
Head of Platform Engineering, NimbusCloud
elena.morales@nimbuscloud.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-21T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Deployment readiness and benchmarking run: plan + acceptance criteria

Looping in Dev and Monica with notes from Elena's reply and the plan. Key internal checklist before Wednesday run: 

1) Confirm model variant: Dev — please confirm we will run q8_onnx optimized variant and that the Dedicated pool has the quantized kernel set ready. If not, can we fall back to q4_onnx with a pre-warm script?
2) Load harness: I will deploy the harness in our test VPC but prefer we run from Nimbus staging IPs; if we must run from Redwood pool, include network latency delta in report.
3) Dashboards & tracing: Monica — can you prepare the Grafana link and a short README showing where P95, P99, token breakdown, and KV cache metrics live? Attach to the run report.
4) Data retention: confirm logs will be kept for 30 days and test artifacts uploaded to the shared Drive folder.

Dev: I'll be available 10/21 07:30-11:30 PT to run the ramp, please confirm.

Thanks — Rishi

Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@nimbuscloud.com>, eng@nimbuscloud.com
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-22T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Deployment readiness and benchmarking run: plan + acceptance criteria (final schedule + acceptance)

Elena — thanks for the staging CIDR and for confirming target burst level. Quick summary and final asks before we kick off tomorrow morning: 

Summary of agreed plan:
- Test window: 2026-10-21 08:00–12:00 PT (controlled ramps) — completed.
- Soak & acceptance: 2026-10-22 09:00–11:00 PT (sustained at 350 concurrency, 10min bursts to 650).
- Model variant: q8_onnx (Redwood Dedicated pool). Dev confirmed kernel set ready.
- Acceptance thresholds: P95 <= 300ms (short prompts), median throughput >= 1200 tok/s, error rate <= 0.5%.

Pre-run checklist (completed):
- Nimbus provided staging IPs and firewall rules (verified).
- Dev pushed quantized kernels to Dedicated pool and pre-warmed.
- Monica created Grafana dashboard and added readme (link in Drive).

Deliverables after run:
- Raw run logs (nimbus-test-run-20261021.log) uploaded to shared Drive.
- Final benchmark report (we will fill redwood-benchmark-template.xlsx and put in Drive).
- Executive summary: 1-page PDF with pass/fail per acceptance criterion.

Next steps (action owners):
- Redwood (Dev + Rishi): execute soak and upload logs by EOD 10/22.
- Nimbus (Elena): review the dashboard during soak and flag any anomalies.
- Grace: compile the final report and schedule a 30-minute post-mortem on 10/23 at 10:00 PT.

Thanks everyone — we'll confirm once logs and the preliminary report are posted.

—
Grace O'Connor
Customer Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
Grace.Oconnor@redwood.ai
